'''Preview''' (Japanese: '''エピソード・ゼラオラ予告編''' ''Episode Zeraora Preview'') is a chapter in [[Pokémon the Movie: The Power of Us: Zeraora's Story]]. It was released as preview for the manga before it officially began its serialization. As such, the events of this chapter are merely an abridged version of the [[ESEZ1|actual first chapter]].

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* {{OBP|Ash Ketchum|M20|Ash}} and {{OBP|Ash's Pikachu|M20|Pikachu}} arrive in [[Fula City]], where they participate in the [[Wind Festival]].
* Ash meets [[Margo]], a young girl living in Fula City.
* Margo tells Ash about {{OBP|Lugia|M21}}, a [[Legendary Pokémon]], and {{OBP|Zeraora|M21}}, a [[Mythical Pokémon]] living somewhere on the outskirts of Fula City.
